update.title: Update to version {{version}}
update.description: This replaces version {{current}}. The panel restarts while it does: your services keep running.
update.safety: The panel's database and key are saved first. If the new version does not start, Swarm brings the old one back and the saved data is restored.

rollback.explain: Version {{version}} can come back. Your data stays as it is.
rollback.explainData: Version {{version}} can come back, with the data saved on {{at}}.
rollback.title: Go back to version {{version}}
rollback.description: The panel restarts into the earlier version. Your data stays as it is, and your services keep running.
rollback.descriptionData: This also restores the data saved on {{at}}: changes made in the panel since then are lost. Your services keep running.

restart.title: Updating to {{version}}
restart.applying: Saving the panel's data and starting {{version}}…
restart.verifying: Version {{version}} has started. Making sure it stays up…
restart.explain: The panel restarts during this, and this page reconnects by itself. Your services keep running.

result.failure: Version {{version}} did not start. The panel is back on {{active}}.
